name: Example App
tagline: A clear sentence explaining what the application helps people do.
description:
Example App solves one specific problem for Mac users. This opening explains what it is without repeating promotional copy.

The second paragraph describes the practical workflow and what distinguishes it from alternatives. Keep every claim factual and supported by a current source.

## Features

- Describe a verified capability and why it matters.
- Add only useful, specific features supported by current sources.
- Explain the core workflow in concrete language.
- State meaningful limitations instead of writing promotional filler.

## Where it fits

Explain who benefits most, how the application relates to alternatives, and its primary tradeoff.

## Privacy and requirements

Explain data storage, cloud processing, accounts, permissions, supported macOS versions, and hardware or service dependencies. Attribute privacy claims to the developer.

## Pricing

State whether the app is free, freemium, a one-time purchase, or subscription-based. Keep this section consistent with the structured pricing fields.
pricingDetails: Free plan; paid plan available monthly or annually.
